sloka: न हि क्षमं तवानेन वैरं धनद रक्षसा ।जानीषे हि यथा ऽनेन लब्धः परमको वरः ।। ७.११.४५ ॥
transliteration: na hi kṣamaṁ tavānena vairaṁ dhanada rakṣasā ।jānīṣe hi yathā 'nena labdhaḥ paramako varaḥ ।। 7.11.45 ॥

translations.english: O Kubera, it is indeed not proper for you to have enmity with this demon, for you know well how he has obtained a supreme boon.
